name: io.github.amisini/careerholo
title: CareerHolo
description: Find open tech jobs from companies' own job boards, match your skills, and see typical pay.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open tech jobs by keywords, place, skills, level, work type, visa sponsorship, pay and posting date. Returns 20 jobs a page, newest first, or the best title matches first when there are keywords. Each job has `url` (its CareerHolo page) and `apply_url` (the company's own page).

query.description: Keywords: a role, skill or company, e.g. "data engineer" or "rust"

location.description: A city, state or country, e.g. "Berlin", "Texas", "Canada", or "Remote"

remote_from.description: Remote jobs open to people in this region

level.description: Seniority: junior includes interns, senior includes leads

skills.description: Skills every job must ask for, e.g. ["Python", "AWS"]

visa_sponsorship.description: Only jobs that say they sponsor a visa

salary_stated.description: Only jobs that state their pay

min_salary_usd.description: Stated pay of at least this, US dollars a year

posted_within.description: First seen within this many days

sort.description: Default: best title matches first when there are keywords

page.description: Which page of results: 20 jobs a page, up to page 50

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: One job's details by the id search_jobs gives: whether it is still open, the description (in full where the source allows, else an excerpt), skills, pay, work type and the links.

tools.name: match_my_skills
tools.description: Rank open tech jobs by how well they fit a person's skills, the way CareerHolo's resume match does: a match percentage for each job, the skills they have and miss, and which skill to learn next for more jobs. Takes skills only, not a name, email or resume text. Nothing sent is stored.

roles.description: Kinds of job wanted; jobs next to them count too

country.description: Where the person works from, e.g. "Germany": jobs there and remote jobs open to it

city.description: A city in that country, e.g. "Berlin"

visa_sponsorship.description: Only jobs that sponsor a visa

tools.name: salary_for
tools.description: The median and typical range of stated pay for a tech role in a place, from open postings, in US dollars a year. Roles: Software, Backend, Frontend, Full Stack, Data, DevOps, Site Reliability, Machine Learning, Mobile, iOS, Android and Security Engineer, Data Scientist, Data Analyst, Product Manager, Engineering Manager, Technical Program Manager, UX Designer, UI Designer, Solutions Architect. Places: Remote, United States, UK, Germany, Netherlands, Canada, India, San Francisco, New York, London, Berlin, Amsterdam, Toronto, Bangalore.

tools.name: company_jobs
tools.description: One employer's open tech jobs, 20 a page, with how many it has open, the skills it hires for and its median stated pay.

page.description: Which page of results: 20 jobs a page, up to page 50

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search open tech jobs with one line of words, e.g. "senior remote rust jobs in Europe" or "data engineer in Berlin with visa sponsorship". Returns up to 20 jobs, each with an id for fetch, a title naming the employer, place and stated pay, and its CareerHolo page.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: One job by the id search gives, as a document: the employer, place, level, pay and skills, then the posting (in full where the source allows, else an excerpt), its page and where to apply.
